verdict.rationale: The CLI operates on SKILL.md template files (skills-cli-gh-15/28/43), installs them as plain files or symlinks to a canonical copy for reuse across agents (skills-cli-gh-16/38/41), and explicitly supports targeting different harnesses (claude-code, codex, cursor, opencode, 73+ agents) with the same skill (skills-cli-gh-5/29). agentskills.io's own claim reinforces 'build once, use across any skills-compatible agent' (skills-cli-docs-1), and a spec validator (skills-cli-docs-4) confirms an open, inspectable format rather than a proprietary binary. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that a skill folder can be manually copied/read without the CLI, and clearer documentation of the raw SKILL.md file structure/contents.
